name: Daisy Cubes Are Strictly Convex-Geometry Ideals
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Every daisy cube has a signed down-set presentation, hence a convex-geometry ideal presentation; a three-direction median path witnesses strictness.
proof: Every daisy cube has a signed down-set presentation, hence a convex-geometry ideal presentation; a three-direction median path witnesses strictness.
